title: ARCADE: ACTION COMES TO YOU
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 14 of 20. A walk-up player should never wander a quiet map looking for a fight, so in the arcade the fight comes to him. Every 22 seconds at the start, and faster as the team score climbs (down to every 10 seconds), a pack of two to six hunters drops in about 800 to 1,000 away and heads straight for one of the players, with WAVE 1, WAVE 2 and so on called out. Crawlers at first, sentries once the team passes 4,000, hostile pillagers from 8,000 and an elite leading every pack from 16,000. It holds off while the players already have enough on them nearby, so it never buries them. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade a pack of hunters drops in near the players every 10 to 22 seconds, bigger and tougher as the team score climbs, with WAVE n called out.
